decision.reason: Baseline char-difference TF-IDF scored 0.638, modestly above majority (0.512). The task appears to require detecting subtle semantic/wording contrasts between paired headlines, which char n-grams on the difference capture only weakly. Trying word-level n-grams on the difference signal (capturing shared-meaning vs. changed-word edits) as a complementary baseline; logistic regression with slightly stronger regularization.
